The '''Wyrd elite guard''' were an elect group of [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tarasin]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who served the [[Wyrd]], a [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="APOD" /> By around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="19 BBY">''[[Heart of Evil: A Plague of Darkness|A Plague of Darkness]]'' is set shortly before ''[[Heart of Evil: A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance|A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance]]'', a [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] adventure that occurs concurrently with the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. As the battle is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the events of ''A Plague of Darkness'' can be placed in circa 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the Wyrd elite guard were diminished in number. In a final gambit to attain victory for the Wyrd, the surviving members of the elite guard supported an effort by the coven to turn the [[ch'hala tree]]s of Cularin, to turn the trees to the dark side of the Force, gathering at the ch'hala [[Heart Tree]] to defend the [[First Witch of the Wyrd]], her [[Unidentified Wyrd second-in-command|second-in-command]] and the Wyrd's [[Inner Circle]] as they initiated a [[Ritual of the Power of the Dark|ritual]] to corrupt the [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. However, the Wyrd and their elite guard were thwarted in their efforts and [[First skirmish at the Heart Tree|defeated]] by the [[heroes of Cularin]].<ref name="APOD" />
